decision: Accept the frozen classifier and proceed to the 500-review checkpoint
rationale: Student reviewed disagreements: severity judgments vary; some human topic omissions reflected unfamiliar languages or interpreting mentioned topics as general phrases. Differences are acceptable to the student.
limitation: Acceptance does not establish instructor accuracy or multilingual sentiment quality; preserve original benchmark diagnostics.

follow_up_statement.source: Explicit student statement during submission review
follow_up_statement.topic_interpretation: After reviewing the model/human disagreements, the student labeler agrees with the model topic classification for the majority of disputed topic cases. This was the reason for continuing the experiment.
follow_up_statement.basis: Qualitative self-report; no new case-level tally or independent adjudication supplied.
